verdict.rationale: Luma documents a Draft Mode for its current video model, with a cheaper 360p Draft tier priced at 20 credits for a 5s text-to-video or image-to-video clip. That covers the fast, cheap drafting half of the story. Nothing in the pack shows an upscale or promote step that takes a chosen draft take to final quality. Missing for 10: a documented upscale-to-final workflow for a selected draft, proof the chosen take carries over consistently to final resolution, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the draft-to-final flow.

support.subject: As a creator, I can draft fast in a cheaper mode and upscale the chosen take to final quality

citations.quote: Current video model — text-to-video, image-to-video, video-to-video with character reference and keyframes, Draft Mode, HDR pipeline
